text.short: Boise, on Grove. A shop with a pintxo counter and paella cooked outside twice a week.
text.today: Paella Wednesdays and Fridays at noon, first Thursdays at 6. Walk up, order, eat on the patio or carry it off. Pintxo Hour keeps the door open to 6 on Thursday, Friday and Saturday.
text.note: It is a market that feeds people, not a dining room. Two people can eat here without sitting down.

x_kitchen.says: pintxos, paella, Spanish and Basque wine, a deli

seating.note: A pintxo counter, a patio, and tables inside. The paella needs no booking — the house says no reservation, no fuss.

hours.text: Tue–Sat 11am–5pm, to 6pm Thu–Sat for Pintxo Hour
